name: Stationary Bike
steps: Set the saddle height so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Sit on the saddle, place your feet on the pedals and hold the handlebars lightly.
Brace your core lightly, keep your shoulders relaxed, and maintain a neutral spine.
Pedal smoothly in continuous, even circles with alternating legs at your chosen resistance and cadence.
Maintain a steady rhythm for the target duration or distance, then reduce resistance and pedal gently to cool down.
tips: Avoid locking your elbows straight or hunching your shoulders toward your ears on the handlebars.
Set the seat properly so your hips do not rock from side to side on every pedal stroke.
